title: Workspace architecture
subtitle: 44 Rust crates: shared foundation, per-ecosystem passes, four frontends

tiers.name: Frontends
tiers.note: one CLI, four server transports, a browser build

tiers.name: Passes
tiers.note: one crate per ecosystem, each declaring its capabilities

tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.note: shared IR ladder, capability model, format ID, MBA, transcoders

footnote: A pass takes one IR rung and returns the next, so the chain runner composes passes across ecosystems through the shared .dr envelope. Frontends never decode a format themselves.
